faqs.q: What causes garage door cables to break in Bolingbrook?
faqs.a: Bolingbrook homes, particularly in areas like Winston Village and Americana Estates, often have original garage doors from 1970s–2000s subdivisions. These builder-grade cables wear out with age and repeated use. Over decades, the metal fatigues. Chicago’s weather, including significant temperature swings, ice, and road salt runoff, also corrodes and weakens cables over time. This leads to fraying or snapping. Lack of regular maintenance can also contribute to premature failure.
